title: spec filter.zod.ts: state the column-side rule — a column with no value fails an ordering operator (nit N1 of #33698's review)
body:
domain:spec#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mecqk8M5q9vjKj6aS

Filing gate: ① (nit N1 of contract record 6894395884 on PR #33854 / card #33698).

**What is missing.** `packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts` says "null is not ordered" about a `null` **comparand**. It says nothing about a **column** with no value. Since PR #33854, the walker in `packages/objectql/src/having-filter.ts` fails `$gt`, `$gte`, `$lt`, `$lte` and `$between` for a column whose value is `null` or absent. driver-sql's `where` compiler already behaved this way. The walker's docblock cites the spec for this rule, but the spec text does not say it.

**Fix shape.** Describe and TSDoc text only. Add one sentence beside the comparand-side sentence: a column with no value fails every ordering operator and `$between`, in every filter position (`where`, a measure's `filter`, `having`). Name the operators whose answer for a column with no value is their own (`$ne`, `$nin`, `$notContains`, `$exists`, `$null`; #5298 ruling A). Regenerate any artefacts the gates regenerate. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, because #33854 carries the semantic change and this card only states it.

Blocked-by: #33698

**Dedupe.** `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open filter.zod.ts null column ordering`: no open card.

Suggested lane: `domain:spec`. Suggested grade: p3 (prose; the rule is already pinned in code). Triage routes and may re-grade.
